native_hardware_delta_query.method: Native swept changed curve sections, selected by unchanged segment records at 1e-7 mm precision, against current front-top/current WAGOs and retained native purchased-hardware/tube fixtures. Bounds are conservative BRepBndLib Add boxes; contacts use exact native intersections.

fixture.retained_hardware_scope: Purchased hardware and tube poses retained; old printed casing, pump cartridge/cap and original WAGOs excluded. Final WAGOs and front-top read separately.

native_wire_delta_query.method: Changed native curve sections against source-native installed conductors; intersecting pairs are compared with their original native routes. The original-route comparison increases the 1.7 mm conductor diameter by 0.00002 mm to suppress coincident-face Boolean noise; this 0.00001 mm radial allowance is numerical classification tolerance.

integration_handoff.scope: Only the 14 named wiring bodies and their route rows are replaced. The physical assembly and other wiring bodies are retained by the integrator.

evidence_limits: Existing unqualified conductor contacts outside the moved local fan-outs remain visible in the pair classifications; this receipt does not claim a contact-free entire harness.
Native routes do not establish physical dressing, terminal insertion, vibration resistance, pull-load capacity or lifetime.
The retained fixture proves the purchased hardware/tube geometry queried here; superseded enclosure/pump pieces and printed cold-core casing are excluded.

manufacturing_cleanup_separation.scope: The fourteen WAGO curves are identical to their original full-wire stock query. Added stock in the d65 successor is separated from every rounded conductor guide hull plus insulation radius; the final rear-breakout successor only removes stock from d65.
manufacturing_cleanup_separation.method: Tangent circular corner fillets stay within the convex hull of their source guide polyline. Expanding that hull by the conductor insulation radius bounds the complete native sweep. A positive Y or Z interval gap proves separation from the entire added-stock bounding box.
